title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Hatsune Miku?
description:
Six real pictures connect Adolf Hitler to Hatsune Miku, through a former king, three presidents and a late-night host.

Adolf Hitler → Edward VIII → Richard Nixon → George H. W. Bush → Barack Obama → David Letterman → Hatsune Miku

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

Photo 4 by Official White House Photo by Pete Souza, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:George_H._W._Bush_and_Barack_Obama_present_the_5,000th_Daily_Point_of_Light_Award.jpg
